title: Area2Ds get_overlapping_bodies returns false overlaps if Area2D contains origin
body:
### Tested versions

Repdroducible in: 4.4.1 stable (Windows 10)

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

- Place Area2D in the scene, the Area2D needs to contain the origin (e.g. Vector(0,0)). 
- Call get_overlapping_bodies() on the Area2D each frame
- Placing a CharacterBody2D in the scene will return an overlap for a single frame, even if there is no overlap


### Steps to reproduce

- Place Area2D in the scene, the Area2D needs to contain the origin (e.g. Vector(0,0)). 
- Call get_overlapping_bodies() on the Area2D each frame
- Placing a CharacterBody2D in the scene will return an overlap for a single frame, even if there is no overlap

The setup can look like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7fbb45f-1d1a-4294-a09d-a7c9a03f50c2)

The Areas2D numbered 1 to 3 show correct behaviour and cause no prints, the Area2D with the number 5 will report the overlap for a single frame (the red underlined print in the image).

(Example above can be found here: https://github.com/The5-2/AreaCollisionBug/tree/main)



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Example can be found here: https://github.com/The5-2/AreaCollisionBug/tree/main or in added file

[areacollisiontest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20677678/areacollisiontest.zip)

Controls in readme file.
